import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

df_melted = df.melt(id_vars=['BMI Category'], value_vars=['Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep'], 
                    var_name='Metric', value_name='Value')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Value', hue='Metric', data=df_melted)
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration and Quality by BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Average Value')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.legend(title='Metric')
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()
